title: Connect to Codex app-server
responsibility: Starts a Codex app-server connection, initializes it and exposes request and event operations.

inputs.name: codexRpc.command
inputs.description: The executable and arguments to start. By default starts Codex app-server over standard input and output with the OpenAI provider selected.

outputs.name: codexRpc
outputs.description: A promise for an initialized connection with send, request, subscribe and dispose operations. Requests use incrementing IDs and a default thirty-second timeout; subscriptions return an unsubscribe function. Disposing terminates the owned process and rejects pending requests.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Initialization failure rejects and disposes the connection. Process failure, closure or an oversized message rejects pending requests. Sending after closure fails. The message reader has a 96,000,000-byte limit.
